It begins with gentle lavender and citrusy bergamot, which is extremely smooth and soothing to the touch. It then shifts, after a while, into a slightly green, spicy heart of geranium and juniper berries, with a new, masculine touch. As it fades, the smell becomes creamier and warmer, with notes of frankincense and oud.

products.body_html: Zimaya Abadi Saga Eau de Parfum is a new modern scent from Zimaya. It comes with a strong, woody, spicy profile that feels bold and creamy. The fragrance opens with fresh citrus and a spicy touch of bergamot, orange blossom, black currant and clove. In the middle, it turns warm and slightly sweet with notes of cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, patchouli and rose. The base is deep and long lasting, with sandalwood, vetiver, musk, tonka, oak moss and pepper.

It opens with a soft blend of rose and oud, giving a slightly sweet, woody feel. As it settles, notes like saffron, leather and amber come in, adding a warm, smooth touch. The base is more smoky and slightly fruity, with raspberry, incense and birch, making the scent feel classy and long lasting.

It was launched in 2020 and features a clean, citrusy and aromatic scent profile. The fragrance opens with fresh grapefruit and bergamot, creating a bright, energetic feel. In the middle, bay leaf, lavender and jasmine add a soft, aromatic, slightly floral touch. The base settles into earthy, warm notes of oakmoss, patchouli and amber, creating a smooth, classy finish.

products.title: Rue Broca On Time Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca On Time Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern masculine fragrance from the house of Rue Broca. Launched in 2024, it features a clean, woody, aromatic scent profile that feels energetic and stylish. The fragrance opens with bright citrusy bergamot mixed with spicy ginger and slightly sharp juniper berries. In the middle, soothing lavender and aromatic sage add a smooth herbal touch, making the scent feel balanced and calm. The base is warm and earthy with vetiver, patchouli and cedarwood, giving it a masculine depth that stays softly on the skin for hours.

products.title: Rue Broca On Time Red Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca On Time Red Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a modern oriental woody perfume for women who enjoy warm, creamy and elegant scents. Launched in 2024, this fragrance opens with a unique blend of saffron, jasmine and woody notes that creates a soft yet noticeable first impression. The heart of the perfume becomes warmer and deeper with ambergris, cedarwood and amber, giving the scent a smooth, slightly sweet feel. As the fragrance settles, musk, fir resin and amberwood build a strong, comforting base that lingers on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Rue Broca Luminus Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Luminus Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a fresh and elegant women’s fragrance. Launched in 2025, this scent carries a soft, floral, fruity profile that feels bright, feminine and smooth. The opening starts with juicy blackcurrant, calming lavender and sweet orange notes that feel light and fresh. In the middle, orange blossom and jasmine add a soft floral touch, making the fragrance feel graceful and charming. The base settles into warm musk, creamy vanilla and cedar wood, offering a gentle, sweet and woody finish.

products.title: Rue Broca Nexa Musée Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Nexa Musée Eau de Parfum is a soft, modern floral perfume for women who enjoy elegant and feminine scents. It opens with fresh fruity notes of tangerine, bergamot and pear that give a light and bright start. The middle slowly blooms with creamy white flowers like orange blossom, jasmine sambac and tuberose which feel smooth and graceful. The base settles into warm notes of vanilla, musk, oakmoss and vetiver that give a creamy, slightly earthy finish.

products.title: Rue Broca Touche Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Touche Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh and spicy men's fragrance with a modern feel. It opens with cool mint and citrus notes, offering a very clean, energetic start. Then it slowly moves into soft floral and spicy notes that feel smooth and balanced. In the drydown, you get warm vanilla, cinnamon and woody notes that linger on the skin.

products.title: Rue Broca Nexa Immortal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Nexa Immortal Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody fragrance for men. It was launched in 2024 and created by perfumer Imran Fazlani. The scent opens with bright, juicy citrus notes of mandarin orange, apple and Calabrian bergamot, which feel clean and energetic. The heart of the perfume offers a soft floral and woody mix of jasmine, cedar, lily of the valley, cashmeran and violet, adding a smooth, slightly powdery touch. The base is warm and earthy, with musk, oakmoss, moss and amberwood that give the fragrance a deep, masculine finish with a long lasting trail.

products.title: Rue Broca Hooked Azure Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Hooked Azure Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern aromatic perfume for men who like a clean, confident scent. Released in 2024 and created by perfumer Imran Fazlani, this perfume opens with soft, fruity and spicy notes of pear, cardamom and lavender that feel bright and smooth. The heart becomes more aromatic with peppermint, rosemary and cinnamon, giving the scent a cool, slightly warm character. As the fragrance dries down, the base of amber, wormwood and vetiver adds a woody, earthy depth that feels masculine and long lasting.

products.title: Rue Broca Hooked Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Hooked Azure Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh and stylish fragrance for men from the house of Rue Broca. It carries a clean, bright scent profile that feels modern and easy to wear. The fragrance opens with juicy blackberry, fresh bergamot and a slight spicy touch of pink pepper, giving a lively start. As the scent develops, soft floral rose blends with woody notes and cypress, creating a balanced, masculine heart. The dry down becomes warm and smooth, with musk, amber and vetiver, which give depth and a long lasting feel on the skin.

products.title: Rue Broca Hooked Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Rue Broca Hooked Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a modern, sweet and warm men’s perfume from the house of Rue Broca. Launched in 2024, this scent has a creamy oriental vanilla profile which feels smooth, cozy and slightly creamy. The opening starts with sweet caramel, mixed with herbal clary sage, which gives a soft, fresh touch. In the middle, the fragrance becomes warmer, with amber, vanilla and light citrus notes that add depth and a little brightness. As it dries down, the base of tonka bean and vetiver gives a smooth, sweet woody finish that feels masculine, warm and long lasting.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum is a creamy and deep scent built around the beauty of the Taif rose. It opens slightly spicy and fruity, giving a warm and interesting start. As it settles, the middle becomes more floral with soft sweetness from rose and saffron. The base feels woody, resinous, and smooth, making the fragrance feel luxurious and long lasting. Swiss Arabian Enigma of Taif Extrait de Parfum has a strong Middle Eastern touch but still feels modern and wearable.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Amber Infusion Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Amber Infusion Extrait de Parfum is a warm, creamy and slightly spicy fragrance made for people who love deep, sweet scents. It opens with a mix of amber, fruity apricot and a spicy touch of cardamom and ginger, which feels both warm and fresh. As it settles, the fragrance becomes smoother and creamier with vanilla and apple sweetness, blended with soft woody cedar and light floral notes. In the drydown, it deepens and becomes bolder, with amber, leather, patchouli and musk, for a long lasting, strong finish.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Vanilla 01 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Vanilla 01 Extrait de Parfum is a rich, creamy vanilla perfume for women with a soft, sweet, warm feel. It opens with a light, floral and slightly spicy touch of orange blossom and pink pepper mixed with coconut. As it settles, you get a smooth blend of cappuccino, caramel, and white florals that feel cozy and addictive. The base is deep and long lasting, with bourbon vanilla, sandalwood, musk and tonka bean, giving it a warm, slightly woody finish.

products.title: Rabanne One Million Elixir Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Rabanne One Million Elixir Parfum Intense is a rich and sweet fragrance launched in 2022. It is made mainly for men but even women who like warm sweet scents can enjoy it. The opening feels fruity and slightly syrupy with apple and davana, giving a smooth sweet start. As it settles, rose and cedar add a soft floral and woody touch. In the dry down, vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli create a deep, creamy and long-lasting finish that feels warm and addictive.

products.title: Clive Christian Amberwood Parfum
products.body_html: Clive Christian Amberwood Parfum is a rich and luxurious oriental woody fragrance made for both men and women. It was launched in 2022 and created by perfumer Ilias Ermenidis. The scent opens with fresh and slightly spicy notes of bergamot, pink pepper, sage, and angelica, giving a sharp and elegant start. Then it moves into deep woody notes with tobacco and patchouli, adding a smoky and smooth feel. The base is very warm and creamy with vanilla, tonka bean, oud, musk, and amber, making it long-lasting and very premium.

products.title: Franck Boclet Vinyl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Vinyl Extrait de Parfum is a woody floral musk fragrance for men and women that feels unique, sweet and slightly smoky. It was launched in 2019 by the brand Franck Boclet. The opening is fresh and citrusy with lemon and mandarin, giving a bright start. The base of vanilla, amber and patchouli gives a smooth, creamy and long-lasting finish that feels rich and addictive.

products.title: Neesh Milky Way Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Milky Way Extrait De Parfum is a warm and creamy fragrance launched in 2020, created by perfumer Remko de Meijere. It is made for both women and men who like smooth, milky and slightly spicy scents. The opening feels soft and unique with milk, mandarin, cardamom and pepper, giving a creamy yet slightly spicy start. As it settles, coconut, magnolia and woody notes add a rich and comforting feel. In the dry down, sandalwood, amber and moss create a deep, warm and long-lasting finish that stays close and cozy on skin.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Golden Amber Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Golden Amber Eau de Parfum is a men's and women's oriental woody fragrance, released in 2022. It begins with deep amber and a little spicy hint of carnation, with a warm and confident beginning. Leather and rose are combined in the heart to create some gentleness and depth. The bottom of birch and citrus makes it durable and unique, as it has a smoky but fresh ending.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Amber Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Amber Oud Eau de Parfum is a male and female oriental floral perfume, released in 2016. It begins with woody, incense, rose and a slight touch of leather, which provides a rich and deep beginning. Cashmere wood, patchouli and musk are applied in the middle to give it a soft and warm touch. It is filled with amber and vanilla to offer a smooth, sweet and long-lasting base on the skin.

products.title: Diptyque Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant oriental woody fragrance made for both women and men. It was launched in 2021, and created by perfumer Fabrice Pellegrin. The scent opens with raspberry, saffron, and pink pepper, giving a slightly sweet and spicy start. Then it moves into leather, iris, and cedar, which adds a smooth and classy feel. The base of vanilla and musk makes it soft, creamy, and long-lasting on the skin.

products.title: Jo Malone London Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense
products.body_html: Jo Malone London Oud and Bergamot Cologne Intense is a men's and women's oriental perfume, which was introduced in 2010. It is designed by Christine Nagel, who has a lot of smooth blends and elegant designs. The perfume starts with fresh bergamot with a bright and somewhat citrusy introduction. It is then topped with rich oud, which gives the drink a rich and woody texture. The entire fragrance is warm, clean and highly sophisticated.

products.title: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense
products.body_html: Jo Malone London Cypress and Grapevine Cologne Intense is a woody aromatic perfume in both male and female versions, which was introduced in 2020. It is produced by Sophie Labbé, who has a classy and smooth scent style. The perfume starts with green and fresh cypress, and it is clean and sharp. Grapevine provides a rather earthy and woody flavour in the heart. The bottom is very warm and deep, which is why it is a classy, modern and long-lasting bottom.

products.title: Kilian Black Phantom Memento Mori Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kilian Black Phantom Memento Mori Eau de Parfum is a dark, rich and very sweet gourmand fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2017. It opens with a deep rum note that feels bold and slightly boozy. As it settles, coffee, dark chocolate and almond create a creamy, dessert-like vibe with a hint of bitterness. In the dry down, caramel, vanilla, tonka and sandalwood give a warm, sweet and long lasting finish that feels heavy and luxurious.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum is a rich, classy men's fragrance from Tom Ford. It was launched in 2012 and made by perfumer Olivier Gillotin. It opens with fresh, spicy notes like bergamot, pink pepper and caraway, giving a sharp yet smooth start. In the middle, you get a mix of floral and spices like rose, nutmeg and black pepper, making it feel creamy and slightly sweet. The base is warm and long lasting, with notes like amber, vanilla, leather and patchouli that give a strong, smooth finish.

products.title: Kilian Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kilian Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum is a warm, boozy and slightly sweet fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2024. It opens with a smooth mix of wheat, davana and bergamot, giving a soft, fruity and slightly aromatic start. As it settles, whiskey and immortelle bring a rich, syrupy and slightly smoky feel with a touch of florals. In the dry down, tolu balsam and styrax create a deep, resinous and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Kilian Apple Brandy on the Rocks Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kilian Apple Brandy on the Rocks Eau de Parfum is a fresh, boozy and slightly sweet fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2021. It opens with a crisp mix of bergamot and cardamom, giving a fresh and spicy start. As it settles, apple, rum and brandy create a juicy and slightly alcoholic feel with a hint of pineapple sweetness. In the dry down, cedar and ambroxan give a smooth woody base that feels clean and long-lasting.

products.title: Afnan Edict Musctique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Edict Musctique Extrait de Parfum is a smooth, musky and slightly spicy perfume that is rich and luxurious to touch. The fragrance opens with a warm, slightly spicy blend of soft musk, saffron, and cardamom. A couple of minutes later, lily-of-the-valley and vanilla introduce a sweet, creamy and soft touch. The dry-down is blended with mint and oud over a rich, woody base that lingers on the skin long after application.

products.title: Afnan 9AM Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9AM Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and slightly spicy fragrance that feels energetic and clean. The scent opens with citrus notes of lemon and mandarin mixed with cardamom and pink pepper, which give a lively start. After a few minutes, soft notes like lavender, orange blossom and green apple appear. In the dry down, cedar, moss and patchouli create a warm woody base that stays nicely on the skin.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Purple Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Supremacy Purple Eau de Parfum is a smooth, slightly sweet fragrance for women who enjoy soft, fruity, warm scents. The opening feels bright with fruits and citrus that give a fresh little sparkle. After some time the scent turns warmer with musk and amber in the middle, which adds depth and softness. In the dry-down, musk and vanilla linger on the skin, creating a creamy, cosy feeling that lasts for hours.

products.title: Afnan Tribute Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Tribute Blue Eau de Parfum is a bold fragrance that is elegant and has a fresh and spicy woody smell. The fragrance begins with a blend of bergamot, nutmeg and pimento seeds which provide a bright and spicy beginning. After a certain period, amber and cashmere wood enhance a warm and smooth sensation in the middle. In the heavier rising, the fragrance is taking on an incense, musk and vetiver deep woody undertoning lasting many hours on the skin.

products.title: Afnan Highness X Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Highness X Eau de Parfum is a bold and warm fragrance that feels woody, slightly sweet and a little spicy. The scent opens with fresh bergamot and black currant mixed with tonka bean which gives a sweet and smooth start. After a few minutes earthy notes, patchouli and vetiver bring a deeper and more masculine character. In the dry down guaiac wood, spices and musk create a warm woody base that stays on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Afnan Historic Doria Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Doria Eau de Parfum is a new, fresh and elegant fragrance, having fruity, floral and soft musky tones. The fragrance starts with plush raspberry, lemon zest and orange blossom that provide a light touch of sweetness. With several minutes, the heart unveils tuberose, jasmine and mandarin orange with a tint of ambroxan, which gives a smooth touch of modernity. Musk and jasmine sambac in the dry down woody notes preclude a soft and sustained base.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Banoffi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Banoffi Eau de Parfum is a rich, creamy and very sweet gourmand fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2025. It opens with a delicious mix of banana and dulce de leche, giving a dessert-like and smooth start which feels very unique. As it settles, vanilla and whipped cream add a soft and milky sweetness. In the dry down, biscuit, praline and musk create a warm, cosy, and long-lasting finish that feels like a sweet bakery vibe.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Pistache Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Pistache Eau de Parfum is a creamy, nutty and very sweet gourmand fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2025. It opens with rich pistachio and pistachio spread cream, giving a smooth and dessert-like start which feels very unique. As it settles, cacao, whipped cream and coconut add a soft, milky sweetness. In the dry down, vanilla, milk and musk create a warm, cosy, and long-lasting finish that feels like a creamy treat.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Vanilla Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and faintly floral scent that is smooth and comfortable. This scent was released on House of My Perfumes in 2024. The first impression is made by bergamot and milk, which makes a fresh but creamy start. Then, later on, frangipani, jasmine sambac, jasmine and lily are introduced into the heart, bringing a floral elegance. Settling down, patchouli, benzoin and musk provide a warm and sweet bottom that remains lingering on the skin through the hours.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Brave Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Brave Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody fragrance that feels clean, energetic and classy. This fragrance was launched in 2024 and created by perfumer Lucas Sieuzac. The opening starts with cardamom, citrus and lemon, which gives a bright and refreshing start with a light spicy touch. After a little time, lavender and geranium appear in the heart, adding a smooth aromatic feel. In the dry down, sandalwood and cedarwood create a warm woody base that stays gently on the skin for hours.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Sheikh Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hamdan The Sheikh Eau de Parfum consists of a warm and woody scent that is rich, smooth and elegant. This perfume was created in 2024 by House of My Perfumes. The introduction begins with bergamot, mandarin and elemi, which provides a light citrus beginning with a hint of resin. Sandalwood, amber, cedar and patchouli are eventually introduced in the heart, giving it depth and warmth. The olibanum, musk and vanilla form a creamy and faint smoky base in the dry down of the tonka bean, which remains for many hours on the skin.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Al Noor Eau de Parfum is a rich and warm fragrance that feels spicy, slightly sweet and deep. The scent opens with cardamom, nutmeg and saffron, giving a bold spicy start that quickly grabs attention. After some time, fig, iris and vetiver appear in the heart, which adds a smooth and slightly earthy feel. As it settles, leather, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli create a warm, creamy base that stays on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Kobra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Kobra Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern fragrance for men from the well known Rasasi perfume house. Launched in 2025, this scent follows an oriental woody style that feels fresh, spicy and slightly warm at once. The fragrance opens with bright, energetic notes of ginger, bergamot and tangerine, offering a fresh citrus start. In the middle, warm cinnamon mixes with green tea and neroli to add a soft, spicy and clean feel. The base settles into a smooth blend of musk, woody notes and amber, giving the scent a warm, masculine finish that lasts for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Rouge Eau de Parfum is a sweet, airy and slightly woody fragrance made for both men and women, launched in 2016. It opens with a fresh fruity mix of nashi pear, kumquat and bergamot, giving a bright and juicy start. As it settles, caramel adds a soft sweetness with a hint of geranium. In the dry down, ambergris, musk and oakmoss create a clean, warm and long-lasting finish that feels smooth on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Scarlet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Scarlet Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity and slightly spicy gourmand fragrance made for women, launched in 2025. It opens with juicy black cherry and a touch of pink pepper, giving a bold and playful start. As it settles, white rose, peony and tonka bean add a soft floral sweetness with a warm hint of nutmeg. In the dry down, vanilla, caramel, sugar and patchouli create a rich, creamy and long lasting finish.

products.title: Lattafa Pure Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Pure Musk Eau de Parfum is a clean, soft and minimal fragrance made for both men and women. It is a simple musk-based scent that feels fresh, smooth and very comforting on the skin. The fragrance stays close to the skin and gives a light, airy feel, perfect for those who like subtle and elegant perfumes without too much heaviness.

products.title: Nusuk Agar Noir Intense Parfum Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Agar Noir Intense Parfum Extrait de Parfum is a bold and smooth men’s perfume made for people who like strong yet classy scents. It opens fresh and spicy with lemon, bergamot, ginger, cardamom and a light watery feel. The heart offers a fruity, aromatic blend of green apple, black currant, lavender, sage, rose and patchouli, giving it a stylish, modern vibe. The base settles into warm, sweet notes of vanilla, sandalwood, cedar, cashmere wood, ambergris and white musk, giving a creamy, long lasting finish that feels confident and refined.

products.title: Riiffs Ardor Intensive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Ardor Intensive Eau de Parfum is a bold, stylish perfume for men who like strong yet smooth scents. It opens with fresh, energetic notes of lavender, apple, bergamot and mandarin orange, giving a bright, lively first impression. The middle features soft floral notes of geranium, violet and jasmine, making the scent feel classy and balanced. In dry down, warm cardamom, creamy vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli blend and leave a long lasting, warm, attractive trail.

products.title: Riiffs Collection De Montano Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Collection De Montano Absolu Eau de Parfum is a stylish woody aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean but strong perfumes. It opens with fresh, slightly sweet fig notes, spicy cardamom and a soft black tea feel. The middle brings powdery iris and earthy vetiver, which gives a classy vibe. The base is warm and creamy with patchouli, woods, tonka bean and vanilla.

products.title: Riiffs Collection De Montano Brave Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Collection De Montano Brave Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s perfume. It is made for people who like cool, watery, citrus scents that feel light yet still noticeable. Riiffs Collection De Montano Brave Eau de Parfum opens with bright citrus and soft green notes, then moves into aquatic and herbal tones and ends with a warm woody base.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Paris Nitro Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody men’s fragrance that feels energetic and masculine. It opens with a sharp citrus blast of grapefruit, lemon, and bergamot that feels clean and lively. Slowly, soft floral notes mix with cedar in the middle, giving it a smooth balance. The dry down is warm and woody with musk, sandalwood, and tonka bean that stays on skin for long hours. This scent feels modern, bold, and perfect for daily wear or evenings.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Paris Nitro Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is an friendly, warm and slightly spicy cologne that is a bold and fashionable feeling among men. It begins with fresh orange blossom, lemon and basil that provide a clean and light beginning. Gradually, the smell becomes more pleasant and has a praline and gentle woody aroma. The notes of amber, patchouli and sweet linger long on the skin in the dry down. It is an excellent fragrance that is powerful, trendy, and befits self-confident men.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, luxurious and amorous perfume among women and men. It opens with warm saffron with a little spicy touch. Gradually, the heart presents black rose and truffle that make the aroma profound, silky and somewhat earthy. Patchouli, vanilla, oud and oakmoss are used as warm and long-lasting sweeteners in the bottom. It is daring, elegant and has an evening dress.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Minerale is a Woody Aquatic fragrance that is used by both women and men. It was launched in 2023. It is a mixture of fresh sea with deep oud, creating a mix of salty air and dark wood. Since its beginning is clean and mineral-like, it then gradually becomes warmer, woody and a bit smoky. It is contemporary, daring, and it suits individuals who prefer fresh but strong perfumes.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Ivory Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Ivory is a soft and creamy women’s fragrance that feels sweet and comforting. It opens with a fresh green mandarin note that gives a light citrus touch. Then comes the heart of orange blossom, mixed with fluffy marshmallow, which is smooth and slightly sugary. In the dry-down, musk and Madagascar vanilla create a warm, cosy scent that lingers close to the skin for hours. It feels classy, modern, and very feminine.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ramad Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ramad Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is fresh and spicy at the same time and suitable for use by both women and men. The perfume begins with a cool, fresh, and energizing combination of cardamom, lemon, bitter orange, and mint. As the fragrance develops, it becomes warm and spicy with overlaps of lavender, cinnamon, and clary sage and nutmeg. In the final phase, the combination of cedarwood, tobacco, amber, and tonka bean creates a rich, velvety, and enduring sensation. This scent gives off an impression that is modern, elegant, and assertive; and it is versatile to be used on an everyday basis and even during extraordinary occasions.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Fahad Regal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Fahad Regal Eau de Parfum is a modern oriental woody perfume made for both men and women. It is soft, warm and classy at the same time. The perfume starts with a pure floral feel of cyclamen, which is cool and soft. Gradually, the heart introduces labdanum, which contributes a slightly sweet, sticky feel. As it dries down, Arabiyat Prestige Fahad Regal Eau de Parfum becomes warm and comforting with cedarwood, vanilla and musk. The base feels creamy, woody and a little sweet, very easy to wear.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Mad Madame Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Mad Madame Eau de Parfum is a Chypre perfume that targets women. Mad Madame was launched in 2012. The smell starts off with the fragrance of rose, black currant, amber and freesia. Patchouli, moss, tuberose, peony and jasmine are characteristic of the heart. It has a deep and warm base that is composed of castoreum, white musk, tolu balsam and vanilla absolute. It is a strong perfume targeted at confident women who prefer strong and persistent perfumes.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Lady Vengeance Extreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Girl Lady Vengeance Extreme Eau de Perrier is a strong, rich and intense chypre perfume targeting women who like aggressive scents. It is black, sexy and bold after the initial spray. The heavy patchouli is mixed with Bulgarian rose and smooth vanilla to produce a warm and slightly sweet scent. This perfume is not tender or modest; it is bold, assertive and crafted to be conspicuous.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Ode to Dullness Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Ode to Dullness is a perfume that targets both men and women. In 2023, Ode To Dullness was released. It is a mushy, musky and creamy smell that is soothing and reassuring to the skin. The perfume starts with a fresh freesia and a hint of star anise. Sandalwood and cashmere flowers provide warmth in the heart. The tonka bean and musk base adds a long-lasting powdery finish, giving a clean and modern feel.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume. Ego Stratis was launched in 2022. It begins with new notes of Bergamot, Lemon and Mandarin Orange. Sea Notes, Calone, Blueberry, Neroli, and Peach are found in the heart. It is crafted out of Ambroxan, Musk, and Cedar on the base, providing it with a clean and smooth finish.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Miss Charming Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Miss Charming Eau de Parfum is a fruity floral fragrance for women. Miss Charming was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with fresh Moroccan rose that smells soft and romantic. After some time, wild strawberry adds a light, juicy sweetness that feels playful and feminine. The base is made of smooth musk, which stays close to the skin and gives a clean finish. It is a delicate, charming perfume, perfect for daily wear and warm days.

products.title: Riiffs Wonder Of You Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Wonder Of You Pour Femme Eau De Parfum is a soft, sweet and warm fragrance made for women who love a little fruity and creamy touch. It opens with juicy pink grapefruit, red apple and peach that feel fresh and playful. Slowly, rose petals, magnolia, and orange blossom come in and give a pretty floral heart. In the dry down, musk, vanilla and amber make it smooth, cosy and long-lasting. It feels feminine, gentle and very easy to wear.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Intense is a fragrance that is Woody Aromatic and is said to be a male perfume. This is a new fragrance. Scandal Pour Homme Intense was introduced in 2025. Quentin Bisch, Natalie Gracia-Cetto and Christophe Raynaud were its creators. The perfume has a clary sage opening, a heart note of vetiver and a juicy leather finish.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense by Gucci is a woman's musky fragrance that is floral and based on wood. It is a new perfume that will be released in 2025. It is initially bright after which it gradually turns creamy and soft to the skin. Gardenia mixed with hedione to a feminine touch is soothing in the heart. The sandalwood base is also a source of warmth and long hours. It is classy, contemporary and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Guy Laroche Drakkar Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Drakkar Intense Eau de Parfum, is a strong and smelling perfume that is refreshing, spicy and deep, typically worn by the male gender. It opens with sharp wormwood, coriander, rosemary and bergamot creating a powerful and clean impression. Gradually, lavender, clary sage, and juniper berries are gradually toning it down and making it finer. Suede, patchouli, lavender and moss in the base are warming and long-lasting additions. It is strong, masculine, and ideal to those men who are strong and confident of strong scents.

products.title: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum For Men is a strong aromatic perfume, which is fresh, spicy and warm simultaneously. It starts bright with bergamot and pepper that have a sharp and clean feel. Lavender and cinnamon creep in slowly, bringing the cool comfort. During the dry down, tonka bean and sandalwood render it creamy and a little sweet. It reeks contemporary, powerful, and assertive, an ideal smell to men who appreciate audacious but refined fragrances.

products.title: Nusuk Fawah Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Fawah Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume made for men who like strong yet fresh scents was launched in 2023. It opens with bright citrus and lavender notes, which feel clean and energetic. The middle comes with earthy patchouli, apple and a light smoky touch that gives depth. The base settles into a warm mix of vanilla, vetiver and lavender, making it smooth and slightly sweet.

products.title: Nusuk Ajwaa Concentrated Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Ajwaa Concentrated Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity-floral women’s perfume for those who like soft yet noticeable perfumes. It opens with juicy notes of black currant, pear and rhubarb, which smell fresh and slightly tangy. The heart comes with white florals like orange blossom and tuberose mixed with rose, giving it a smooth, feminine feel. The dry down turns warm and creamy with sandalwood, woody notes and hazelnut, making the scent cozy and slightly nutty.

products.title: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum is a fresh and airy unisex perfume from the house of Nusuk. It was introduced in 2025 and has a light, cool and refreshing clean aquatic style. The fragrance begins with the fresh and luminous scent of lemon and bergamot. Heart mixes sage, geranium and ozonic notes, which are breezy and herbal to some extent. The base settles into soft moss, musk and light amber, creating a smooth and relaxing finish that stays gentle on skin and pleasant in the air.

products.title: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, warm perfume made for both men and women. It opens with juicy and honey like notes of honey, blood orange, apricot and lemon, which give a fruity, sweet start. The heart comes creamy and tasty with coconut, caramel and soft magnolia. The dry down feels smooth and cozy with vanilla absolute, musk and sandalwood.

products.title: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum is a new unisex floral scent from Nusuk Fragrances. Released in 2025, it offers a soft, fruity floral style, with light smoky and musky tones. The opening starts with incense, fennel, and sweet red fruits, giving a slightly warm and juicy feel. The heart blooms with peach, osmanthus and jasmine, which smells smooth and floral. The base settles into sandalwood, rose, and musk that feels creamy, gentle and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Ivory Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Ivory Eau de Toilette is a men's perfume of the woody fragrance, which is fresh, yet a bit smoky and warm too. The initial spray begins with a light bergamot that is so fresh and invigorating. In several minutes, lavender appears, and it brings a warm aromatic touch with a certain warmth of fire. Woody and smoky tones remain on the skin for hours in the base. The smell is male, sophisticated and ideal for all men who prefer a fresh perfume that has a more profound nature.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum is a rich and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with fresh geranium, pink pepper, and a touch of citrus that feels bright and slightly sharp. After some time, the heart becomes warm with red peony, cardamom, and saffron, giving a soft spicy feel. In the base, oud, vetiver, patchouli, and musk create a deep, smoky, and long-lasting trail. It feels bold, elegant, and perfect for someone who likes strong woody scents.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Limited Edition Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Limited Edition Parfum is an intense, fresh, and smoky men's scent that is quite rich and elegant. Initially, it is composed of fresh lemon and pineapple that are shiny and harsh, and then little by little it becomes somewhat smoky and floral in the middle. Eventually, it gives a warm, musky, and woody smell to the skin. This fragrance has the traits of a bold, manly, and luxury scent that is appropriate for those men who enjoy strong and long-lasting perfumes that attract attention.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Lionheart Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Lionheart Man Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is warm, sweet and slightly fresh and is designed for men who are sure of themselves. The fragrance starts off with a fresh combination of mint and lavender which is clean and soothing. After a while, the scent becomes opulent with vanilla and benzoin adding a creamy sweet character. The combination of honey, tonka bean, and tobacco in the base note makes it profound and enduring. This perfume radiates strength, modernity, and is ideal for nighttime use.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: The Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant and strong perfume suitable for both genders. The perfume has a very fruity, fresh and lively opening of pineapple, lemon and bergamot, mixed with a delicate sweetness of caramel. Gradually it transforms to a woody and mild spicy smell, and finally it is deep, warm, and smooth with amber, leather and vanilla. The fragrance has an aura of elegance, daring, and persistence.

products.title: Nusuk Ana Al Awwal Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Ana Al Awwal Silver Eau de Parfum is a bold and fresh leather scent made for men who like a clean yet strong smell. It opens with bright, fruity and fresh marine notes mixed with soft lavender and spicy pepper. The middle comes with soft florals and woody cedar that feel smooth and balanced. The base is warm and masculine with leather, musk and patchouli, giving a classy and lasting trail.

products.title: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum is a cool and warm oriental perfume that is aimed at both women and men. It begins with a spicy ginger touch combined with bright bergamot, which is a clean and slightly sharp beginning. The heart then soon introduces a juicy feel of grapefruit that adds freshness. Musk and ambroxan base enable it to be smooth, soft, and long-lasting on the skin. It is contemporary, elegant, and comfortable.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum is a rich and smooth oriental floral scent made for both men and women. The heart is soft and floral with orange blossom and jasmine, balanced by gentle woody notes. As it dries down, vanilla, musk and amber come together to give a warm, sweet and cozy feel.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and modern unisex perfume from the house of Arabiyat Prestige. As it settles, soft florals and a creamy sweetness start to show, making it smooth and pleasing. The base is warm and woody and a little sweet, making the perfume to be in balance and very comfortable.

products.title: Lattafa Ekhtiari Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ekhtiari Eau de Parfum is an Aromatic Fruity perfume of both women and men. Ekhtiari was launched in 2019. products.title: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Mashrabya Eau de Parfum is a hot and sweet unisex perfume, which is deep and somewhat smoky. It starts by flavouring a fruity apple shisha touch blended with soft pink pepper, which is a very sweet beginning but a little spicy. Tobacco, cinnamon and dates are used in the middle to form a very rich and warm feel. The oud smoke, caramel, vanilla and patchouli base make it smooth, dark and long-lasting. It is daring, contemporary and fits better in cooler seasons.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nebras Elixir by Lattafa is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Nebras Elixir was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Nanako Ogi. Top notes are Milk Candy and Whipped Cream; middle notes are Sugar Cane and Heliotrope; base notes are Vanilla, Ambroxan and Musk.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum is a tropical and spicy unisex scent that feels fresh, warm, and smooth. It opens with juicy mango, pineapple, rhubarb, and bergamot with a little ginger and pink pepper spice. The heart brings saffron, cardamom, and soft woody tones, while the base of ambergris, sandalwood, musk, and cypriol gives it a long-lasting warm finish. It is classy, bold, and easy to wear for many occasions.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Hypnotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for oud lovers. This scent opens with spicy and floral notes that feel warm and slightly sweet. As it settles, the deep oud mixes with caramel and soft woody tones, giving a smooth and addictive feel. The base is creamy and warm with vanilla and amber, which makes the fragrance feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Blanche Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: L'Aventure Blanche by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Floral fragrance for women. L'Aventure Blanche was launched in 2017. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Lavender and Rose; middle notes are Black Currant, Jasmine, Orris and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Sandalwood and Amber.

products.title: Nusuk Malika Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Malika Eau de Parfum is a graceful, classy women’s perfume for those who like soft yet creamy scents. It opens with a fresh citrus note of orange and bergamot, bright and clean. The heart blooms with jasmine and rose, giving it a gentle floral feel that smells feminine and smooth. As it settles, sandalwood adds a warm, woody base that makes the scent feel calm, elegant and long lasting.

products.title: Al Haramain Detour Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Detour Noir Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm and spicy unisex perfume from Al Haramain fragrances. It opens with fresh apple and lavender with a soft floral touch of jasmine and violet. The heart becomes creamy with vanilla and citrus notes, and the base settles into smooth sandalwood, cardamom and pepper. The overall scent feels cozy, sweet and elegant with a modern Arabic style.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels luxurious and strong but still smooth. It opens with fresh citrus and spicy notes, then slowly moves into a warm heart of amber, patchouli and oud. The dry down is creamy and soft with vanilla, sandalwood and white musk, which stays close to skin and feels very elegant.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige La Di Da Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige La Di Da Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet spicy men’s perfume made for everyday confidence. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel clean and energetic, then slowly moves into warm spicy tones. The dry down is soft, sweet and musky, which makes the scent feel smooth and easy to wear. Arabiyat Prestige La Di Da Homme Eau de Parfum feels fresh at first and later becomes warm and comforting on the skin.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum begins with a sunny and juicy combination of litchi and bergamot that is smooth and bright. After a certain period, there are soft floral tones of peony, freesia, orange blossom, and jasmine emerging and rendering the smell graceful and creamy. The foundation of musk, sandalwood and moss provides a fresh and clean woody feel that lasts many hours on the skin. This perfume is fresh, floral, and a bit sensual, which is ideal for those who like soft yet powerful luxury fragrances.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco is a men-oriented Oriental Spicy fragrance. It was launched in 2024. This aroma begins with pink pepper, black pepper, cardamom, elemi and sage which creates an impression of freshness and spiciness. Tobacco in the heart is combined with chestnut, cinnamon leaf and a touch of soft chili, which adds flavor and a warmness. It is smooth, sweet and long-lasting on the body, with the help of the base of bourbon vanilla, amber, guaiac wood and benzoin.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Ghost Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Ghost Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern woody aromatic scent made for men who like strong yet clean perfumes. It opens fresh and spicy with ginger, cardamom and bergamot, giving a sharp, energetic start. The heart turns slightly sweet and spicy with pink pepper, blackcurrant and rose, adding depth and smoothness. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, cedarwood and patchouli, which stays on skin for hours, feels classy but not heavy.

products.title: Ajmal Avid Homme Deodrant

The top notes carry fresh and fruity tones, merging into a woody aquatic heart that exudes an enlivening effect on the wearer. The top and heart culminate into a fascinating base, full of warm amber and patchouli to make the creation cast its charm.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Homme Deodrant

products.title: Ajmal Sacred Love Femme Deodrant

products.title: Ajmal Sacrifice Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal Sacrifice II Perfume Deodorant for Men is a captivating fragrance that embodies strength, elegance, and a modern sense of masculinity. This 200ml deodorant offers a long-lasting scent experience, keeping you feeling fresh and confident throughout your day.

products.title: Ajmal Shadow Femme Deodrant
products.body_html: The Ajmal Shadow Perfume Deodorant is the ultimate fragrance choice for the modern woman who seeks to leave a lasting impression. With its enticing blend of floral and woody notes, this perfume deodorant is designed to captivate the senses and accentuate your unique allure.

products.title: Ajmal Shadow Homme Deodrant

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful and very feminine fragrance made for women who enjoy soft gourmand scents. As it settles, Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum turns warm and comforting base with vanilla and soft musk.

products.title: French Avenue Aether Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aether Extrait de Parfum is a cool and smooth perfume that targets both women and men. Resting down, soft wood and violet emerge and give the smell a tranquil and harmonious smell. The foundation is musky and a little earthy, leaving a natural and long lasting finish, which is easy to wear and modern.

products.title: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum is a sweet, playful women’s perfume. It opens with a strong cherry feel that smells juicy, a little boozy and slightly nutty. As it settles, soft fruits and florals come out, making it feel romantic and smooth. The base is warm, creamy and comforting with vanilla and woods that stay close to the skin. This perfume feels fun, cozy and perfect for someone who loves sweet cherry based scents.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum French Avenue is a fresh, fruitful and a bit warm perfume that is produced to suit both men and women. The fragrance is long lasting as the base is comfortable and full of musk, sandalwood, and amber.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum is a modern floral women’s perfume for those who like soft but noticeable fragrance. Launched in 2024, it brings a fresh and clean floral style built with bright bergamot in the opening, a heart of jasmine and neroli, and a soft musky base with ambrette.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Parfum

The smell is fresh, followed by soft leather and a rich woody smell. It is also daring, elegant and targeted at men who prefer strong, long-lasting perfumes in a timeless fashion.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, spicy perfume for both men and women, launched in 2013. The base is creamy and smooth with vanilla, tonka bean, musk and patchouli.

products.title: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum is a fresh and luxurious perfume for men and women. Light spice and warmth are introduced as it settles with ginger and herbal notes. The musk, cedar, amber, orris root, and patchouli base provide a creamy woody finish, which lasts many hours. It is very memorable, luxurious and very contemporary and lightweight.

products.title: Xerjoff Tony Iommi Deified Parfum
products.body_html: Deified Tony Iommi Parfum by Xerjoff is a perfume that is utilised by women and men. In 2024, it released Deified Tony Iommi Parfum. The bottom of papyrus, patchouli, musk and moss provides a woody, ground and deep-seated end that is daring and extravagant.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Universe Eau de Parfum

Musk, amber and cedar base provide a warm woody finish which remains well-behaved on the skin hours later.

products.title: Lattafa Fire on Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fire On Ice Lattafa Perfumes is an Oriental Vanilla perfume for both men and women. This is a new fragrance. Fire On Ice was launched in 2025. The depth, warmth and powerful lasting power are provided by oak, myrrh, cedarwood and ambroxan in the base. It is warm, rich and comfortable to wear in the evening.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Raw Bourbon Eau de Parfum

products.title: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody men's perfume, which is clean, smooth, and classy. It begins with the ripe apple and sunny bergamot touch that is vigorous and crisp. Gradually, the heart is made more of cedarwood and soft violet, so that it feels rather peaceful and slightly dusty. On its foundation, oakmoss, musk, and amber provide a very cosy and lasting effect. It is stinking of modernity, confident, and easy to wear.

products.title: Lattafa Shaheen Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Shaheen Gold Eau de Parfum is a new feminine and masculine perfume that is light, smooth and a little warm. The initial spray scents of a juicy pineapple and grapefruit are energetic and vibrant. Fig and lavender arrive gradually and bring about a soft and creamy taste. Vanilla, tonka and patchouli are used in the base to give a comfortable and cozy enduring finish that is felt even after several hours. It is contemporary, comfortable and hygienic.

products.title: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum is an oriental fragrance available for women and men. It was released in 2016 and developed by perfumer Aurélien Guichard. This fragrance begins with the notes of frankincense, raspberry, saffron and pear that are a bombard of smoky and sweet sweetness. Damask rose, musk and orange blossom, agarwood (oud) and leather with patchouli and ambergris are reported to be the damask rose, the base, and the other, respectively. It is courageous, intense and highly opulent to the skin.

products.title: Hermes Terre D’Hermes 80ml Hair and Body Showergel
products.body_html:
Hermes Terre D’Hermes 80ml Hair and Body Showergel For Men

A hair and body formula which transforms into a pleasant, generous lather; easy to rinse. Delicately perfumed, the skin is soft and the hair shiny. Another way to wear fragrance with Terre d’Hermes. Terre d’Hermes narrates the relationship between man and earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with the elements of nature. It is the perfume that connects man to his origins, to the source of his creative power.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Sun Song Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Sun Song Eau de Parfum is a bright and fresh citrus perfume for women and men. It was released in 2019 and designed by Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. The perfume begins with a clear and juicy citron, which is clear and active. Orange blossom then adds the sweetness of a soft, floral taste. The musk in the bottom provides it with a smooth and warm feel that remains close to the skin. It reeks of summer sunshine, light, happy and easy to wear. Its weight is not excessive, it is not too sweet, and it is only fresh and glowing.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. It mixes fruity, green and warm amber notes to create a modern everyday scent. The opening feels juicy and bright with bergamot, green notes and mandarin orange. The heart becomes sweet and tropical with melon, black currant and pineapple mixed with smooth amber. The base is soft and creamy with musk, petitgrain, galbanum and vanilla, giving a long lasting finish.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Louis Vuitton Spell On You Eau de Parfum (LV x TM Limited Edition)
products.body_html: Spell On You Eau de Parfum by Louis Vuitton is a feminine fragrance that is a soft and floral scent. It is romantic, whitish and feminine. The smell begins with violet, Tuscan iris, and green that provide a fresh and even airy beginning. Then it gradually drifts into a gorgeous centre of iris, rose and jasmine, which is smooth and elegant. The foundation of white musk, peach, and acacia is soft and warm, sticks to the skin and can be considered elegant.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Symphony Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Symphony Extrait de Parfum is a women's and men's citrus fragrance, released in 2021 and developed by Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. It starts with a powerful, juicy note of grapefruit that is refreshing and invigorating. The smell remains pure, silky and luxurious on the skin. It is an extract that is long-lasting and feels richer than an ordinary fresh perfume, which is best worn in summer and during the day.

Dumont Paris Nitro Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Paris Nitro Intense Eau de Parfum is a dark and strong men's perfume that has a sweet and woody touch. It begins with juicy pineapple and black currant, which smells opulent and faintly fruity. It becomes slowly warm with smoky aromas and spices which are very strong and manly. The dry down is creamy with vanilla, amber and woods that remain on the skin throughout long hours. This fragrance is strong, up-to-date and self-assured.

products.title: Roja Apex Eau Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Roja Apex Eau Intense Eau de Parfum is a fresh, green and strong perfume that is intended to be worn by both men and women. Produced by Roja Parfums, this 2025 collection is self-confident and contemporary. It starts to be very bright and herbal and gradually becomes woody and smooth. The combination of mint, citrus, grass and woods is rather strong in the sense of nature, even though it sounds classy and rich.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Rose Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Rose Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and romantic floral women’s perfume for those who love elegant rose perfumes. Launched in 2023, this fragrance opens with juicy plum, which feels slightly fruity and fresh. The middle is full of rose petals and peony, giving it a creamy floral touch that smells clean, smooth and very feminine. The base settles into warm ambroxan, creamy vanilla and soft musk, which makes the scent feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Riiffs Angelique Extrait de Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Angelique Extrait de Vanilla Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and smooth unisex scent from Riiffs. Launched in 2021, it is a creamy vanilla-forward fragrance that blends fruity, floral, spicy and woody tones in a very balanced way. The opening starts with soft vanilla orchid, juicy plum and jasmine. The middle feels sweet and cozy with tonka bean, cinnamon, suede, sugar, bark and rose. The base dries down into a warm blend of amber, patchouli, maple and musk, offering a creamy, slightly dark finish that stays close and pleasant on skin.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern citrus aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean, bright scents. It opens with juicy citrus notes that feel sharp, fresh and very uplifting. As it settles, warm spices and soft florals come in, giving it a smooth and balanced heart. The base is calm, woody and slightly smoky, with a clean tea note that stays classy on skin.
