products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Platinum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nitro Paris Platinum Eau de Parfum is a contemporary woody fragrance perfume targeting men who prefer serious and sweet perfumes. It begins with a fresh and juicy combination of spices and fruits that is vibrant and vigorous. Gradually, it becomes warm and smooth vanilla, sugar, and soft woods. The foundation is deep, creamy, and long-lasting with a great and assertive feel. The perfume seems trendy, very expensive and can be worn daily or on nights.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum is a powerful and enticing perfume that is suitable for women and men to use. It starts off with a sweet, fruity raspberry smell that is mixed with fresh bergamot and light cinnamon spice. The aroma becomes sweet, creamy and comprises cotton candy, soft rose, and powdery orris. The dry down has a thick, dense fragrance that mixes leather, oud, vanilla, and wood notes that last long after application in the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix Royal X Taboo Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix Royal X Taboo Extrait de Parfum is a thick and dense perfume that is warm, smooth and not bold. It begins with a sweet and warm aroma of spicy cardamom and cinnamon. Gradually, the smell becomes a warm tobacco and cashmere wood smell, and it is a classy and addictive one. Vanilla, tonka bean, and dry woods remain on skin throughout the day in the dry down. The perfume is luxurious, powerful, and ideal to those who prefer having a strong and lasting perfume.

products.title: French Avenue Grecia White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Grecia White Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and elegant unisex perfume made for people who like calm but noticeable scents. It opens with a smooth milky note mixed with ambrette, giving a clean and comforting feel. The heart has white florals like tuberose and jasmine with a light touch of incense that adds depth but is not smoke heavy. The base is warm and sweet with vanilla, musk, tonka bean and cacao, which stays gentle on skin for a long time.

products.title: French Avenue Veneno Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Veneno Eau de Parfum is an ambitious and innovative perfume, designed to attract both men and women. It starts with a fresh and juicy apple aroma with smoky and spicy cinnamon that is quite enticing. Tobacco and moss make it sink into the earth as it sinks. Bourbon vanilla and orcanox base are what provide a feeling of warmth and sweetness to be long-lasting on the skin. This perfume is powerful, elegant and suitable with the self assured individuals.

products.title: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold and cozy fragrance made for both men and women. It starts with a creamy blend of incense and coffee, which has a hint of rose that provides a nice beginning. The cedar and cashmere wood make the heart stiff and chilly, which gives the scent a rich texture. As it dries down, Spicy Amber becomes creamy and slightly sweet with vanilla, mixed with earthy vetiver and clean musk.

products.title: French Avenue Royal Bourbon Blend Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Bourbon Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold and smooth aromatic fragrance made for both men and women. It opens with spicy and fresh notes that feel rich and strong from the first spray. As it settles, the bourbon note comes out and gives a deep, slightly boozy feel that smells classy and confident. The dry down is woody and soft, with oak and balsam base notes that stay on skin for long hours.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace Oryn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace Oryn Eau de Parfum is a fresh and energetic citrus perfume made for men who like clean and bright scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy mandarin, orange and bergamot that feel fresh and uplifting from the first spray. The heart has a spicy ginger note that adds a sharp and warm touch. The base settles into smooth ambergris, giving the scent a soft, masculine finish that stays pleasant and classy.

products.title: French Avenue Mystic Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Mystic Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and dark unisex fragrance. Released in 2024, this perfume starts with a smoky and spicy blend of saffron and incense that is mysterious right after a spray. The Sweet touch of sugar cane mixed with warm amber and soft violet is added in the middle and it adds a sense of balance and smoothness. The base settles into creamy sandalwood and earthy patchouli, leaving a strong leather like trail that feels classy and powerful but still wearable.

products.title: French Avenue Genesis Capricon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Genesis Capricorn Eau de Parfum is a deep, smoky and warm unisex perfume made for people who like bold and dark scents. It opens with strong incense and smoky notes that feel mysterious and calming at the same time. The middle has labdanum and balsam fir, which adds a resin like, forest touch that feels rich and smooth. As it settles, the base becomes warm and slightly sweet with benzoin, guaiac wood, amber and soft vanilla.

products.title: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. It opens fresh but slowly turns dark, warm and very luxurious. The fragrance starts with bright citrus notes, then moves into soft florals and finally settles into a heavy oud and musky base. French Avenue Divini Aoud Eau de Parfum feels classy, slightly wild and very strong in character.

products.title: French Avenue Giovanni Lorenzi Tesoro Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Giovanni Lorenzi Tesoro Eau de Parfum is a bold, rich perfume for men who like strong, classy scents. It has a warm, amber and leather feel and a sweet and spicy touch. This men’s perfume is inspired by 1 Million Parfum by Paco Rabanne, but it still has its own strong character. It is fresh and juicy on the opening, spicy and floral in the middle and deep, warm and slightly smoky on the base.

products.title: French Avenue Exotic Rose Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Exotic Rose Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern rose based fragrance for both men and women. Launched in 2023, this perfume blends the richness of saffron with soft rose and a touch of spice. The opening feels warm and slightly exotic, while the heart stays floral with a gentle peppery edge. The base of patchouli gives depth and an earthy finish, making it a balanced and long wearing scent.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Noir Eau de Parfum is a deep, smooth and elegant unisex fragrance introduced in 2022. It opens with soft powdery iris mixed with fresh cyclamen and juicy cassis, giving a calm but prosperous start. The heart feels floral and earthy with patchouli, rose and jasmine adding warmth and balance. As it dries down, vanilla, amber and leather come together to create a creamy, slightly sweet and bold base that stays close to skin and feels very luxurious.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau De Parfum is a warm and creamy unisex fragrance, which is smooth to the touch and a bit sweet. The introduction is a fresh combination of bergamot, orange and soft spices, which createsa bright but warm introduction. Gradually, coconut and ylang ylang blend into a rich and soothing creamy floral heart. The musk and sandalwood foundation gives the skin a rich, warm woody fragrance that lingers in the skin for many hours. This perfume is classy, contemporary and suited to those who like warm oriental perfumes with a smooth twist.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Hedonist Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Hedonist Eau de Parfum is a smooth, woody-smelling fragrance that is targeted at both men and women. At the same time, it is clean, fresh, and warm. The smell starts fresh and a bit spicy, and gradually turns woody and tender. It is not overpowering, but it is good and opulent to touch. This perfume is ideal for individuals who enjoy sophisticated, contemporary and durable scents that are relaxing and assured.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal. It is a soft yet deep floral scent with a warm oriental touch. The perfume opens with sweet fruity notes of blackcurrant and apricot mixed with fresh freesia. A beautiful rose with patchouli and gentle osmanthus flowers is felt in the middle of the perfume. The base is warm and very long lasting, with musk, oud and frankincense giving it an Arabic, luxurious feel.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh, woody, and spicy character. Launched in 2017, it combines bright citrus, warm spices, and earthy woody notes into a smooth and elegant composition. The perfume opens with fresh top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper, moves into a spicy and floral heart of neroli, nutmeg, and cardamom, and finally settles into a grounding base of vetiver and woody notes. It is a versatile scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum is a deep, bold, and intense unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent feels dark, spicy and smoky right from the first spray. It starts with a strong touch of incense combined with fresh citrus and warm spices that creates a strong first impression. As it dries, Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum grows more multifaceted and full bodied, the pleasant earth patchouli smell, tender flower and spice aromas fading in. It is heavy and long lasting with the smell of frankincense, oud, amber, vanilla and resin that are warm and mysterious and very luxurious.

products.title: Clive Christian X Masculine Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Clive Christian X Masculine Eau de Parfum provides a masculine scent that is very luxurious and elegant, with a warm and opulent smell. The perfume starts off with a fresh and sweet aroma of pineapple and bergamot mixed with rhubarb. The perfume moves on to a blend of tender iris and jasmine, with a touch of spicy paprika to make it a luxurious and sophisticated feel. The fragrance base is made of a strong woody aroma of cedar and amber, combined with vanilla and cinnamon to produce a strong masculine smell that will last the day.

products.title: Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern unisex fragrance from the house of Afnan. Launched in 2025, this perfume is rich, warm and slightly spicy with a smooth, sweet touch. It starts with powerful spicy notes that are lively and strong, then gradually transitions to a soft heart of leather and lavender. The vanilla and patchouli base at the end creates a milky, warm and soothing feeling. Afnan 9PM Elixir Eau de Parfum feels classy but is still easy to wear.

products.title: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal Scents. This perfume is all about smooth musk blended with gentle floral and warm amber tones. It opens with a fresh and calming touch of lily of the valley, giving a clean and airy feel. As it settles, creamy musk takes over and stays close to the skin, making it comforting and classy. The warm amber and extra musk in the base contribute to the longevity of the fragrance and create a cozy feeling around it.

products.title: Ajmal Raindrops Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Raindrops Eau de Parfum is a soft and elegant women's perfume who like clean and fresh scents. It is a lovely combination of soft, sweet and woody that is very feminine and delicate. The perfume is at first very soft and fruity with floral accents, then gradually leads to a warm base of wood and amber.

products.title: Hermes Terre d’Hermes Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Terre d'Hermès Intense is a heavy and aggressive men's fragrance. It begins with fresh bergamot and spicy black pepper, which is sharp and strong. Next comes coffee and soft licorice which gives it a dark and slightly sweet flavour. It has a solid base of woody notes with lava and stone that provide it with a solid and strong finish. It is grown-up, sophisticated and ideal with men who prefer powerful and poignant perfumes.

products.title: Lalique  White Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Lalique White Eau De Toilette is a fresh Citrus aromatic men's fragrance. It is clean, sharp and classy as soon as it sprays on. The introduction is sunny and lemon leaf and bergamot create a cool and somewhat tangy impression. It is smooth and settles down, unearthing soft spices such as white pepper and cardamom. The cedar and the musk provide a smooth woody foundation in the dry down, which remains on the skin.

products.title: Bvlgari  Rose Goldea Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Eau De Parfum produces a feminine and soft smell that is filled with a romantic and elegant touch. The smell has a fresh and rosy start with a delicate fruity scent that creates a clean and light impression. The fragrance evolves into a floral heart that harbours the smell of rose and soft flowers. The lower level of the perfume is a blend of warm fragrances and creamy musk, sandalwood and vanilla, which are still close to the skin. The perfume gives a very elegant, feminine smell that can be used on a daily basis.

products.title: Lattafa Bayaan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bayaan Eau de Parfum is a pleasant and luxurious women's perfume that is fruity, flowery and slightly creamy. It starts and becomes sunny and fatty, but then gradually becomes gentle and cosy to the skin. The rose, praline and vanilla blend make it very rich and smooth. It is a stylish and at the same time fun smell that will appeal to the women who enjoy sweet scents and have a bold flavour.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition Eau de Parfum is a warm, creamy and bold unisex perfume. This fragrance is made for people who love deep, sweet and spicy tobacco style scents. It opens with strong notes of tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, which feel spicy and cozy at the same time. The heart is creamy and sweet with vanilla, cloves, star anise, tonka bean, cacao and incense, giving it a smooth, addictive feel. The base settles into tobacco dried fruits and woody notes that feel warm, luxurious and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Al Qiam Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Qiam Eau de Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that feels clean, woody, and modern. It opens with a burst of grapefruit and ginger, which gives a bright and spicy freshness. After that, the heart of the perfume is made by ambroxan and sandalwood, giving a slightly warm and soft woody smell. The base consists of musk and vetiver, which produce a warm and earthy dry down that is very close to your skin. It is fresh but deep, ideal for everyday use or special occasions.

products.title: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum by Versace is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum was launched in 2014. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh notes of Sicilian lemon, pomegranate and Calabrian bergamot, which feel juicy and energetic. The heart brings a soft floral mix of lemon blossom, jasmine sambac, jasmine and peony. In the base, sandalwood, musk, ambroxan and woody notes create a warm, smooth and long-lasting finish that feels elegant and feminine.

products.title: Khadlaj Cloud Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Khadlaj Cloud Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy perfume by Khadlaj Perfumes, targeted at both men and women. It is released in 2025 and provides a soft, candy-like touch with a warm and cosy feel. Cloud Candy begins on a sweet and light note that is almost fluffy, as though sugar is melting in the air. 


The heart becomes creamier and smoother after a couple of minutes, which resembles the sensation of a candy shop. When it fades, it becomes warmer and softer, keeping close to the skin in a warm and cosy sweetness. It is light-hearted, light, and somewhat addictive and is ideal for those who enjoy sweet smells that are not heavy but are easy to detect.

products.title: Le Labo Fleur d'Oranger 27 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: A soft yet strong fragrance in floral Fleur d'Oranger 27 by Le Labo is a women's and men's fragrance. It was released in 2006 and made by perfumer Francoise Caron. The smell is fresh, clean and somewhat warm concurrently. Here, the star is orange blossom, which has an unadulterated white floral fragrance, which is light yet slightly erotic.

products.title: Amouage Decision Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Decision Eau de Parfum is a modern woody aromatic fragrance made for both men and women. This perfume is deep, calm and confident in nature. A fresh and spicy opening leads into a warm, resinous heart which ends with a gentle, woody base. Amouage released this fragrance in 2025, which perfumes people to express their unique personality.

products.title: Versace Eau Fraiche Extreme Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eau Fraiche Extreme Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh fragrance scent for men that is clean, to some extent spicy and woody. The introduction is characterised by lemony and orange blossom that is pleasingly citrusy and vibrant, with a slight spicy touch of pink pepper. It is given a gentle aromatic touch after some time by lavender, clary sage, and geranium. During the dry up, the ambroxan, musk and cedar form a smooth woody foundation that is retained for hours on the skin. It is classy, clean and certain, excellent for individuals who like a sophisticated smell on a daily basis.

products.title: Amouage Purpose 50 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Purpose 50 Extrait de Parfum is a deep, rich and powerful unisex fragrance from the luxury house of Amouage. Launched in 2025, this perfume is a more intense and concentrated version, made for people who love strong, long lasting scents. It begins with a strong combination of frankincense, pimento, pink pepper and fresh bergamot that makes it spicy and smoky. The middle provides a warm and balanced smooth sandalwood, earthy vetiver, papyrus and soft rose. The base is deep, creamy and sensual, using akigalawood, suede, mystikal, vanilla and saffron.

products.title: Le Labo Cedrat 37 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Cedrat 37 Eau de Parfum is a clean and fresh unisex fragrance that is bright immediately after spraying. It begins with crisp citron, which smells natural, juicy, and bitter to some extent. Warm ginger is then added, providing a mild spicy feel. Musk, woody and ambergris at the bottom form a long-lasting and smooth finish. It is easy and elegant, contemporary and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Amouage  Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum is a rich, deep and powerful men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Amouage. It was launched in 2020 as a stronger and more intense version of the original Interlude Man. The scent opens with spicy and green notes of oregano, pimento and fresh bergamot. As it settles, the heart becomes dark and smoky with incense, amber, opoponax and labdanum. The base is heavy, warm and masculine, filled with smoke, oud, leather, patchouli and sandalwood.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern scent made for men who like simple but classy perfumes. It begins with very refreshing minty and juicy citrus with a cool feeling and lots of energy. It gradually goes to soft and spicy middle notes that are then followed by smooth and soft woody and musky base notes that remain on the skin.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oulil Amr Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oulil Amr Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy strong oriental scents from the Ahmed Al Maghribi house. It opens with a soft spicy touch of cardamom mixed with fresh peony, which feels calm but noticeable. As it settles, the middle note brings powerful Laotian oud and Cambodian oud blended with rose, giving it a classic Arabic feel that smells royal and warm. The base is smooth and long lasting with pine, musk and amber that stay on skin for many hours.

products.title: Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern unisex fragrance from Abdul Samad Al Qurashi. Launched in 2024, this scent feels clean, airy and refreshing from the first spray. Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum opens with bright citrus and spice, then moves into a calm lavender heart and finally settles into a soft, earthy base.

products.title: Tom Ford Eau d' Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Tom Ford Eau d ombre Leather Eau de Toilette is a men's fragrance made of leather. The fragrance is new and was introduced in 2024. The name behind this perfume is Sonia Constant. The cardamom, Ginger and Coriander are the top notes, Vanilla and Leather are the middle notes, and ambrofix is the base note. It starts spicy/ fresh and then goes smooth and a little sweet with soft leather. The dry down is warm, clean and contemporary. It is more daring yet easier to wear than the Eau de Parfum version, which is ideal for men who are fond of elegant leather perfumes.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Shower Gel
products.body_html: A gentle and foaming shower gel to recreate the Lazy Sunday Morning cocooning memory every day of the week. Relive your most self-indulgent Lazy Sunday Morning each day with a new REPLICA perfumed ritual.

products.title: Elie Saab Girl of Now Shower Gel
products.body_html: Bathe your skin in this rich shower gel scented with Elie Saab's Girl Of Now fragrance. Skin feels cleansed and revitalised with a delicate floral scent.

products.title: Diptyque  Fleur De Peau Hand & Body Gel
products.body_html: A tribute to the sensual, stimulating qualities of musk. On contact with water, this gel becomes an unbelievably silky cleansing foam. Enriched with shea butter, it perfumes the body intensively while leaving it softened and invigorated. Musk, with nuances of iris and ambrette seed, enhances the skin with a timeless fragrance.

products.title: Diptyque  Eau Rose Shower Foam
products.body_html: An indulgence. Upon contact with water, Eau Rose shower foam is transformed, becoming as velvety as whipped cream. The transparent gel evokes an infusion of roses, combining floral damascena notes with fruity accents of litchi. Softens and scents the skin.

products.title: Dior Miss Dior Blooming Powder
products.body_html:
Miss Dior is a hymn to love, emblematic of Dior femininity with a Couture spirit. A hand-crafted trail of scent with a modern, rebellious and elegant personality.

This Miss Dior rose scented powder wraps the body in a luxurious veil of softness. Its light, airy formula illuminates skin with iridescent shimmer. In just one step, your skin is enhanced and the trail of your Miss Dior fragrance is intensified.

products.title: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Shower Gel
products.body_html: Surrender to the intense vitality of the Amalfi coast with the versatile dual-purpose hand and body wash tinged in Fico di Amalfi’s nectar accords with green note of leaves, leaving skin cleansed and lightly scented in the enveloping and enchanting scent.

products.title: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette is a French fragrance brand in the form of a Woody Aquatic men's fragrance. In 2022, Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette was released. The top notes include Sea Notes, Calypsone and Nutmeg, middle notes include Pine and Patchouli, and the base notes include Sandalwood and Cedar.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Rose des Vents Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Rose des Vents Eau de Parfum is a soft and fresh floral fragrance for women. It feels light, elegant, and very classy. The opening has juicy peach and black currant with green notes that give a clean and airy vibe. In the heart, different roses bloom with iris, making it powdery and smooth. The base of white musk, cedar, violet leaf and pepper adds a soft warm touch that stays close to the skin. It feels feminine, gentle, and very graceful.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Mousuf Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ard Al Zaafaran Mousuf Eau de Parfum is a sweet and warm, but a little bit dark, fragrance created for women who are fond of heavy scents, The fragrance opens up with a delicious and soft mixture of grapes and chocolate that is very inviting. It calms down and the warmth and depth of the oud and musk are felt. In the end, toffee, tobacco, and delicate florals linger on the skin for hours. This perfume gives the impression of being sweet, soft, and very addictive.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh and clean character. It is very refreshing and uplifting due to its bright citrus opening smell. The aroma’s development gives a very soft aromatic touch that is very light and comfortable to the nose like the beautiful skin. Essentially, this perfume is a simple and fresh daily use fragrance for the wearers who prefer clean and unobtrusive yet recognizable scents.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Shower Gel
products.body_html: Sailing Day by Maison Martin Margiela is a fragrance for women and men. Sailing Day was launched in 2017. Top notes are Sea Notes, Aldehydes, Coriander and Red Pepper; middle notes are Juniper, Iris, Amyl Salicylate and Rose; base notes are Seaweed, Ambergris, Cedar and Amberwood.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Body Lotion
products.body_html: Sailing Day by Maison Martin Margiela is a fragrance for women and men. Sailing Day was launched in 2017. products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Fireplace Shower Gel
products.body_html: By the Fireplace by Maison Martin Margiela is a Woody fragrance for women and men. By the Fireplace was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Marie Salamagne. Top notes are Cloves, Pink Pepper and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Chestnut, Guaiac Wood and Juniper; base notes are Vanilla, Peru Balsam and Cashmeran.

products.title: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey Body & Hand Wash
products.body_html: Nectarine Blossom & Honey by Jo Malone London is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. Nectarine Blossom & Honey was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jo Malone. Top notes are Green Notes, Black Currant and Petitgrain; middle notes are Nectarine and Black locust; base notes are Peach, Plum and Vetiver.

products.title: Hermes Neroli Dore Hand & Body Cleansing Gel
products.body_html: Refreshing aroma of a classic cologne with every wash. This cleansing gel's harmonious blend crafted by Françoise Caron in 1979, promises a sensory journey through the lush groves of the Mediterranean, leaving your skin revitalized and delicately perfumed.

products.title: Hermes Eua De Neroli Dore Moisturising Balm
products.body_html:
Moisturizing and protective, this smooth balm rich in hydrating and emollient agents soothes the skin and offers an immediate sensation of comfort, making it feel supple and soft.
Non-greasy, it can be used on the face, hands and all over the body.

products.title: Guerlain Shalimar Shower Gel
products.body_html: For a moment of complete wellbeing, indulge yourself with Shalimar shower gel and its silky smooth gel that lathers into a rich and generous foam on contact with water. Its smoothing and moisturising* properties leave the skin feeling soft and delicately scented.

products.title: Diptyque  Solution Hand Wash
products.body_html:
Hailed since antiquity, fine lavender from Provence lends its regenerative qualities to this soothing hand wash.
Restoring the gentle feel of the skin, it also delivers lavender and rosemary notes softened by subtle accents of ylang-ylang and amber.

products.title: Diptyque  Pommade Smoothing Body Polish
products.body_html:
This velvety body polish with exfoliating grains delivers all the benevolence of the pomegranate, queen of fruits.
Perfumed with Arabian jasmine, pink peppercorn and peach, this rich, creamy-textured care product combines the fine qualities of pomegranate oil, jasmine floral water and peach butter.

products.title: Diptyque  Philosykos Hand & Body Gel
products.body_html:
Cleanse, soften and scent skin in one fell swoop with Diptyque Philosykos Hand and Body Gel, a luxurious bath and body skincare solution from the master Parisian perfumers.

This lavish gel formula transforms to a silky light foam on application. It gently and thoroughly cleanses the skin, while the added shea butter works to hydrate and nourish for long lasting moisturising effects.

products.title: Diptyque  Gellavant Shower Gel
products.body_html: In the shower or bath, its light foam stimulates the mind while enveloping the body and hair in a delicate perfume of bergamot, green tangerine and honey from neroli oil.

products.title: Diptyque  Eau De Minthe Shower Foam
products.body_html: Eau de Minthé by Diptyque is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. Eau de Minthé was launched in 2019. Top notes are Mint and Nutmeg; middle notes are Geranium and Rose; base note is Patchouli.

products.title: Diptyque  Creme Rich Butter
products.body_html:
Driven by the Byzantine rose, this smooth cream, as luscious and addictive as Turkish delight, quenches dry skin.
As luxurious as fresh butter, this care product envelops the body in a delicate perfume. In its sillage, Damask rose mingles with myrrh and the power of Peru balsam.

products.title: Dior Gris Hand & Body Soap
products.body_html: Gris Dior by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Gris Dior was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Hair Mist
products.body_html: Club de Nuit Intense Man by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Club de Nuit Intense Man was launched in 2015. Top notes are Lemon, Pineapple, Bergamot, Black Currant and Apple; middle notes are Birch, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambergris, Patchouli and Vanilla.

products.title: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Silver Eau de Parfum is a clean, confident, fresh, and classy fragrance for men. It starts with rosemary, petitgrain and a bit of pepper that provides a sharp and green beginning. Neroli, orris and jasmine are employed in the middle to bring about a floral smoothness. Its earthy, long-lasting and woody smell is contributed by the bottom of cedar, vetiver and patchouli. It is contemporary, clean and suitable in every day use.

products.title: Khadlaj Nuha Vanilla Pearl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Perfumes Nuha Vanilla Pearl is a women's fragrance, Floral Fruity Gourmand. This is a new fragrance. In 2025, Nuha Vanilla Pearl was introduced. It begins with plump blackcurrant and strawberry mixed with sweet freesia. The heart also includes raspberry, cashmere wood and magnolia giving a creamy floral flavor. Its base is sweet and vanilla, caramel and moss-flavoured with a smooth and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Khadlaj Cafe Latte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Cafe Latte Eau De Parfum is a sweet gourmand perfume for both women and men. Khadlaj Cafe Latte was opened in 2024. Coffee, Sweet Almond and Milk, Vanilla, Ice Cream and Amber, Vanilla, Almond Cream and Caramel are the top, middle, and base notes.

products.title: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum is a bold, oriental, spicy male perfume that opens fresh and slightly sharp, featuring notes of grapefruit and pink pepper. A clean touch is added by lavender, followed by warmth and richness from amber and cedarwood. Patchouli, moss and musk are used in the dry down to form an even, long-lasting dark base. It is powerful, contemporary and suitable for self-confident men who prefer luxurious evening perfumes.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Tropical Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Tropical Eau de Parfum is a fresh, tropical scent for men who like cool, green, slightly sweet perfumes. Launched in 2025, this scent opens with juicy coconut water, green fig leaf and spicy ginger, which gives it a lively start. The middle features creamy coconut, fresh fig and mint, making it feel breezy and clean. The base is soft and warm with sandalwood, tonka bean and musk, creating a smooth tropical trail that smells modern and relaxed at the same time.

products.title: Khadlaj La Fede Choco Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj La Fede Choco Brown is a unisex fragrance that is rich and creamy and has a warm and sweet touch the moment it is sprayed. It starts with intense cocoa and gradually turns into creamy chocolate with pistachio and milk that creates a rather creamy dessert atmosphere. It settles into a prolonged and warm vanilla and caramel that remains intimate to the skin. This smells good, bold and ideal to the gourmand perfume lovers.

products.title: Khadlaj Fursan White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Fursan White Eau de Parfum is a perfume used by women. Fursan White was launched in 2024. Bergamot and Jasmine are the top notes, Musk, Coconut and Almond are the middle notes, and Vanilla, Cedarwood and Nutmeg are the base notes. It starts with fresh bergamot and a slight touch of jasmine that is clean and bright. After several minutes, coconut and almond arrive, adding musk to it, making it feel milk-like. Vanilla, cedarwood and nutmeg are present in the dry down to provide a warm and soft spicy feel. It is stylish, comfortable and highly comfortable.

products.title: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfume is a fresh and smooth citrus perfume that is applied by women and men. The initial spray is a cool blend of bergamot, lavender and mint that is refreshing and invigorating. It has slow, soft, fruity, and flowery notes coming in slowly, giving it a touch of light sweetness. Woody notes, powdery accords and incense form a cool, slightly smoky, enduring finish that lingers on the skin hours later in the dry down. It is contemporary, stylish, and comfortable to put on at all times.

products.body_html: Warm Vanilla Sugar by Bath & Body Works is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Warm Vanilla Sugar was launched in 2021. Top notes are Vanilla and White Orchid; middle notes are Vanilla, Sugar, Tonka Bean, Coconut and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood and Cacao.

products.title: Azzaro  Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Parfum is a powerful and fashionable perfume that is deep, bold, and contemporary men perfume. It starts with a plump touch of raspberry blended with fresh green mandarin and bergamot and it has a slightly sweet fresh start. Warm spices and soft lavender trickle out slowly and the smell becomes smooth and manly. The leather bottom is opulent and strong, remaining in contact with skin a long time. The perfume is perfect for men who prefer bold and strong smells.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Castley Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Castley Eau de Parfum is a fresh, spicy, citrus scent for men from the luxury house of Parfums de Marly. Launched in 2025, it opens with bright, energetic notes of bergamot, grapefruit, ginger and black pepper that give a sharp, fresh start. The middle comes with neroli, petitgrain, pepper, timur and rose, which adds a little spicy floral touch. The base settles into warm notes of akigalawood, benzoin, labdanum and leather, making it smooth, classy and slightly bold but still fresh and clean.

products.title: Orto Parisi Viride Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Viride Extrait de Parfum is a bold green and woody unisex perfume from the artistic house of Orto Parisi. Launched in 2014, it is known for its raw, natural smell, which feels earthy, fresh and slightly smoky at the same time. The scent opens with herbal green notes of wormwood, artemisia and lavender; moves into soft floral jasmine in the middle; and settles into a deep forest like base of fir, juniper, cedar, tobacco and musk.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Valaya Exclusif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Valaya Exclusif Eau de Parfum is a soft, elegant and creamy floral women’s scent for those who like gentle but rich perfumes. The perfume opens with a sweet citrus note, featuring smooth almond, fresh mandarin and bergamot. The middle contains powdery scents of orange blossom, lily of the valley and lotus, creating a clean, fresh, feminine scent. The base of the fragrance develops warm vanilla with ambroxan and sandalwood, white musk, heliotrope and akigalawood, which create a smooth, comfortable and elegant scent with a refined, luxurious touch.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant scent. Released in 2023, this perfume feels light yet classy with a fresh, fruity, floral style. It opens with airy aldehydes, juicy white peach, bergamot and mandarin orange. The heart brings soft florals like orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and modern notes like Petalia and Nympheal blended with light vetiver and mahonia. The base dries down into smooth musk, creamy vanilla, ambroxan and woody akigalawood, giving it a clean and comforting finish.
